jobs.title: Executive Assistant - ETS Strategy and Planning
jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant serves as a coordination resource within Enterprise Technology & Security (ETS) Strategy and Planning, supporting the planning, execution, and tracking of key initiatives across ETS and the broader corporate environment. This role helps organize activities, maintain visibility into deliverables, risks, dependencies, and process improvement efforts, prepare for meetings, and coordinate timely follow-up with internal teams, leadership, vendors, and other stakeholders. Working closely with the Vice President and other ETS leaders, the Executive Assistant helps maximize time and focus by aligning work with top organizational priorities. The Executive Assistant is a proactive, detail-oriented professional who helps ensure projects are organized, aligned to business priorities, and delivered effectively and efficiently.
Required Education/Experience - Bachelor's Degree and 3 years of experience supporting Senior Management, or
- Associate's Degree and 4 years of experience supporting Senior Management, or
- High School Diploma/GED and 5 years of experience supporting Senior Management.

Relevant Work Experience - Advanced digital and AI proficiency, including expert use of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and AI tools such as Copilot to enhance productivity, automate workflows, and generate high-quality outputs, required.

- Ability to efficiently retrieve, interpret, and relay messages from email, Microsoft Teams, and phone communications, and respond as appropriate, required.
- Exhibit a conscientious work ethic with strong presentation and interpersonal skills, required.
- Be flexible with work hours to address time-sensitive business and system needs, required.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft, edit, and deliver executive- and board-ready materials with clarity, precision, and impact, required.
- High attention to detail with forward-looking mindset, demonstrating the ability to anticipate needs, proactively plan, and prioritize competing deliverables in a fast-paced environment, required.
- Must be a self-starter and have the ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities, required.
- Must be able to exercise independent judgement and discretion in the coordination of meetings, reports and information while maintaining a strict level of confidentiality, required.
- Experience supporting a VP, SVP, President or C-level executive, preferred.

Skills and Abilities - Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organizational skills
- Well organized, detail oriented and flexible to handle multiple assignments
- Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment

Physical Demands - Sit or stand to answer a phone for the duration of the workday
- Sit or stand to use a keyboard, mouse, and computer for the duration of the workday

Core Responsibilities
- Provide sophisticated calendar management. Prioritize inquiries and requests while troubleshooting conflicts; utilize judgments and recommendations to ensure efficient time management.

jobs.title: Steam Organization, Operations Manager - 59th St Station, Operations
jobs.description:
The Operations Manager will direct all activities related to the safe, reliable, efficient and economical generation of steam and electricity. This position will oversee the 24/7 rotating personnel responsible for safe plant operations. Additionally, this position will establish and continuously review performance standards, operating procedures, work methods and procedures, and departmental objectives.

This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan.
Required Education/Experience - Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 8 years of full-time relevant work experience in an operating area or
- Master's Degree and a minimum of 6 years of full-time relevant work experience in an operating area

Preferred Education/Experience - Master's Degree in Engineering or a related field and a minimum of 6 years of full-time relevant work experience in an operating area

Relevant Work Experience - A minimum of 5 years of prior direct or indirect supervisory experience, required
- Work experience or knowledge of outage coordination, required
- Ability to interpret and analyze operating reports, map and blueprints, required
- Knowledge of steam generating systems; steam/power utilities and steam distribution systems, required
- General knowledge of all steam distribution equipment and administrative processes as well as company processes, required
- Thorough working knowledge of the General Instructions Governing Work on System Electrical Equipment (Rule Book), Steam Operations Procedures, safe work practices and procedures, operating orders & work permits and use of appropriate personal protective equipment, required
- Proven record of fostering the principles of the teamwork with other Steam Operations groups and Company departments to achieve results, required
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office and computer mainframe based business application, required
- Working knowledge of the Work Management Systems (e.g. Maximo, DataSplice, AutoLog, COSRS), required

Skills and Abilities - Effective leadership skills
- Effective interpersonal skills
- Builds and manages effective teams
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

Licenses and Certifications - Driver's License Required
- Other: Ability to acquire Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) Card 180 Days Required
- Other: NYC Stationary Engineers High Pressure Preferred

Physical Demands - Ability to respond to system emergencies
- Able to work in all weather conditions, i.e. excessive heat and/or cold
- Ability to carry tools and materials when climbing ladders and scaffolds, and entering confined spaces
- Ability to work in adverse conditions that include, noise, confined spaces, and high elevations
- Ability to climb ladders and stairs
- Ability to work on elevated platforms, scaffolds, catwalks, roofs, and/or other equipment
- Ability to work in inclement weather and adverse conditions (i.e., excessive heat, cold, noise, confined spaces)
- Ability to work with, and in, the vicinity of high voltage and/or other high-energy systems
- Stand, walk, lift, climb, bend, kneel, stoop, and/or reach for the duration of the workday
- Ability to travel to company locations to work on storm restoration and heat contingencies

Additional Physical Demands - The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Able and willing to travel within O&R and CECONY service territory, as needed
Core Responsibilities - The Operations Manager will direct all activities related to the safe, reliable, efficient and economical generation of steam and electricity. This position will oversee the 24/7 rotating personnel responsible for safe plant operations. Additionally, this position will establish and continuously review performance standards, operating procedures, work methods and procedures, and departmental objectives
- Make sure that safe work practices are followed and the environment is fully protected in accordance with Company policy and governmental regulations. Serve as a Safety champion and ensure implementation of Company safety, health and environmental programs for all employees
- Ensure the Operations Department adheres to the Steam Operations Standards and Expectation Guidelines for Operations Personnel
- Provide leadership and control for the daily management of the station, maintain material condition of plant and operating equipment, and support the work management process
- Validate that the work groups are following safe work practices in accordance with OSHA regulations and all corporate, central operations and station level procedures
- Respond to emergencies at any time, and act as Incident Commander as necessary, and ensure adequate training and qualifications are obtained
- Ensure Control room conduct is maintained in a professional manner to minimize distractions
- Effectively communicate appropriate procedural changes, lessons learned, and engineering plans and specifications to supervisors to ensure the proper operation and restoration of Steam generation and electric generation equipment
- Ensure timely and accurate reporting of plant status, derates, maintenance and forced outages
- Review and update existing operating procedures with the Shift Supervisors. Create and implement new operating procedures where necessary. Ensure compliance to procedures by the operating group
- Perform appropriate Managerial functions in the interview and placement process of new and transferring personnel. Follow through to ensure timely action on labor issues
- Ensure the proper and required training and/or licensing of employees, and compliance with all regulatory agencies, such as FDNY, DEC, DEP, PSC USCG, NERC,FERC and their stated permits: SPDES, Title V, MOSF,PBS,CBS is maintained at all times
- Administer the work permit process and conduct monthly technical audit of OO/WP
- Promote a customer service focus among supervisors, mechanics and operators, while emphasizing professionalism, honesty, concern, courtesy, excellence and teamwork
- Authorize the installation of temporary modifications and temporary operating instructions
- Prioritize new and pending work requests and coordinate work efforts with the planning group
- Strive to improve morale and productivity of subordinates. Strong knowledge of Company rules, terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement and the grievance process. Determine appropriate disciplinary action, conduct disciplinary interviews, participate in settlement of grievances, and evaluate subordinates' work performance in a timely manner
- Perform quality control reviews
- Create/Encourage a culture that engrain Zero Accident, Operational Excellence, Effective Cost Management, Diversity and Inclusion, and Enhancing the Customers Experience
- Perform other related tasks and assignments as required

jobs.title: Project Manager - CET Electric Transmission - Business Development
jobs.description:
Capital Project Delivery (CPD) is seeking is seeking a Project Manager of Business Development in the Con Edison Transmission (CET) Electric Transmission organization responsible for the evaluation and development of potential transmission development opportunities throughout the Northeast. The Manager of Business Development will manage projects from origination through development, including creating work plans, developing business and financial models, managing internal and external subject matter experts, navigating electric transmission projects through complicated regulatory and permitting processes. The position also includes structuring business development partnerships that meet CETs needs as well as the needs of our partners and presenting opportunities to executives for evaluation and review.
Required Education/Experience - Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 8 years relevant work experience with the assessment and financial modeling of investment opportunities or
- Master's Degree and a minimum of 6 years relevant work experience with the development of infrastructure projects

Relevant Work Experience - Prior experience in energy infrastructure, energy commodity markets, energy policy and regulatory affairs, finance, accounting or related department, preferred Preferred
- Analytical skills and commodity/resource and/or financial modeling, required
- Project management of deliverables from multiple types of customers, required
- Have the ability to multi-task, work independently, exercise discretion, and maintain confidentiality, required
- Have excellent communication skills, required

Licenses and Certifications - Driver's License Required

Additional Physical Demands - The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Must be able and willing to travel domestically and internationally, as needed.
- Must be able to perform field visits.
Core Responsibilities - Con Edison Transmission (CET) is a regulated subsidiary of CEI which owns and develops electric transmission assets. CET is currently working on multiple opportunities to grow its electric transmission portfolio. The Project Manager, Business Development in Electric Transmission is responsible for evaluation of potential investment opportunities, focused on New England, New York, PJM and interregional opportunities in the Northeast USA. The Project Manager of Business Development will manage project development from the solution origination stage through the initial development phase. This includes creating work plans, developing business and financial models, managing internal and external subject matter experts, and navigating electric transmission projects through complicated regulatory and permitting processes. The Project Manager will be responsible for negotiating contracts with partners and customers and communicating the details of potential business opportunities to CET and CET leadership for evaluation. Lastly, they will help the organization achieve its overall strategic growth objectives.
- The Project Manager will be responsible for specific projects related to business development, investment assessment, partnership structure, and management oversight of electric transmission projects and investment opportunities. The Project Manager may also be called upon to review and evaluate potential M&A opportunities, as well as project manage due diligence and transaction execution for such opportunities. The Project Manager must be capable of designing and executing detailed work plans for the development phase, including managing multiple teams of internal and external subject matter experts.
- The Project Manager will be expected to be able to clearly and succinctly present their analytical results, suggested deal structures, and opportunities for improvement. They will also be expected to represent CET in negotiating situations with other parties, with the guidance of senior management.
- The Project Manager should be team-oriented and is expected to support other CET initiatives, regulatory position development and advocacy, marketing, special projects, and assignments as needed to support CETs business plans and objectives.
- Work with partners and industry participants to develop potential electric transmission opportunities.
- Analyze industry developments that impact CETs current and potential investments, including commodity market fundamentals and regulatory & legislative developments. Monitor NYISO, PJM and ISONE by attending and participating in various stakeholder/industry meetings and events.
- Ability to evaluate and understand commodity and resource modeling, including the impact of new transmission projects.
- Coordinate with internal and external subject matter experts to evaluate feasibility and constructibility of projects through the permitting phase.
- Provide review of financial analysis to determine rates and project economics for current and potential investments. Understanding of revenue requirements modeling over project lifetime is needed.
- Supervise and mentor Analyst(s) and consultants in support of projects and tasks to achieve CETs strategic objectives.
- For projects in the construction phase, work with partners on oversight, cost management, and project management of investments.
- Participate in enterprise risk management activities to help CET understand rising or falling risks and to appropriately mitigate those risks.
- Meet regularly with CET and CEI leadership to communicate the details and status of active projects.
- Travel is required primarily as part of project development including to identify potential projects for development as well as to meet with partners and potential partners, as appropriate.

jobs.title: Clean Energy Manager (Compliance and Risk Manager)
jobs.description:
About the Team & Mission:
Con Edison, a multibillion-dollar energy utility, is leading the clean energy transition in New York City and Westchester County. We are investing hundreds of millions of dollars annually to integrate distributed resources into our electric and gas systems, support electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and scale adoption of energy efficiency and clean heating technologies across our customers.

This is a great role to demonstrate your ability to drive results, apply cross-disciplinary skills to the clean energy space, collaborate closely with diverse teams, meaningfully support customers, and gain firsthand experience with the clean energy transition.

Role Overview:
The Clean Energy Manager will support the prevention, detection, and mitigation of regulatory, financial, compliance, and reputation risks in Distributed Resource Integration (DRI) organization which includes E-Mobility, Distribution Planning, Energy Storage, and Digital Products and Demo Teams. The individual will support the Compliance Section Manager to ensure that the department adheres to best practices, Company policies and procedures, regulatory rules and requirements in all aspects and levels of our business.

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Project Specialist to evaluate business processes, identify operational risks, drive efficiency through data-driven solutions, and help set and reinforce a strong culture of compliance. The role is ideal for a process thinker with strong analytical and research skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for continuous improvement.
Required Education/Experience - Bachelor's Degree and 5 years' relevant work experience in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering or equivalent or
- Master's Degree and 3 years' relevant work experience in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering or equivalent

Preferred Education/Experience - Master's Degree and 3 years' relevant work experience in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering or equivalent

Relevant Work Experience - Ability to build positive relationships with colleagues who have a diverse set of experiences and approaches to drive business results, required.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and organize large, complex data sets, required.
- Demonstrated ability to manage tense, complex, or technical internal customer issues in a calm, thorough, and professional manner, required.
- Demonstrated agility and flexibility to deal with ambiguity and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, required.
- Strong communications, presentation and writing skills, required.
- Highly proficient in Microsoft Office suite (i.e. Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint), required.
- Proven experience in financial analysis, business process analysis, risk management, auditing or operations improvement, required.
- Proficiency in digital data collection and processing tools, required.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, required.
- Previous auditing or compliance-based experience, preferred.
- Ability to prioritize tasks based on financial impact and organizational goals, required.
- Strong problem-solving skills and commitment to continuous improvement, required.
- Experience designing dashboards, metrics and reporting frameworks, preferred.
- Internal Customer-oriented mindset and collaborative working style, required.

Licenses and Certifications - Driver's License Required

Additional Physical Demands - The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Must be able to respond to Company emergencies by performing a System Emergency Assignment to restore service to our customers.
Core Responsibilities - Create, update, and revise internal policies and procedures that ensure compliance-focused knowledge of department practices associated with program activity. Establish and document standardized procedures, including end-to-end timelines, dependencies, handoffs, communication protocols, and reporting expectations.
- Track the implementation recommendations from audits, internal reviews, and regulatory filing requirements. Monitor and follow up with program teams to ensure continuous progress. Coordinate and contribute to the departments response to regulatory examinations, audits, and inquiries.
- Analyze large and complex programmatic, financial, and operational datasets to identify issues, anomalies, and trends; and assess program performance, control effectiveness, and data integrity using both quantitative and qualitative techniques. Perform statistical sampling and quantitative analysis to design representative samples, analyze results, measure financial and operational impacts, identify trends, and assess program performance and data quality over time.
- Establish and document standardized QAQC processes and procedures (SOPs), including end-to-end timelines, quality checkpoints, dependencies, handoffs, communication protocols, and reporting expectations. Define and apply clear QAQC decision criteria, including pass/flag/fail thresholds, cure requirements, and standardized corrective actions, ensuring consistent, defensible outcomes across reviews.
- Regularly interact with all team members of the department and uses relationship skills to influence and achieve compliance objectives. Collaborate cross functionally with program, operations, finance, data, and policy teams to problem solve, incorporate findings into program design and operations, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
- Design and conduct targeted internal studies that simulate audits or formal evaluations (for internal use), such as assessments of overall program performance, incentive calculation accuracy, data quality, energy consumption, customer behavior.
- Synthesize and communicate QAQC, risk, and evaluation findings through clear written reports, executive ready presentations, dashboards, and innovative data visualizations, presenting results on a recurring cadence (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually) and highlighting trends, risks, control effectiveness, and actionable recommendations for program teams, management, and department leadership.
- Support the departments compliance program by conducting risk assessments, developing risk logs, developing appropriate policies and procedures, CEO certification oversight and engaging in monitoring and training activities to enforce the objectives of the program.
- Ability to create, organize, and update SharePoint sites including but not limited to calendars, documents, and overall maintenance.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, and perform other related duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Management Associate (EP), Leadership Development Program (LDP)
jobs.description:
As one of the worlds largest energy delivery companies, Con Edison is a trailblazer in technology, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and transmission, with a strong commitment to clean energy policy and sustainability. We are driving the transition towards a cleaner future by spearheading advancements in renewable energy production, transmission, and distribution. Join us as we pave the way towards a more sustainable and resilient energy landscape, where innovation meets environmental responsibility. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about shaping the future of clean energy and contributing to a greener planet.

Our Leadership Development Program (LDP) has three program tracks: Engineering, Information Technology, and Business. As a recent college graduate, this comprehensive 18-month rotational leadership development program will introduce you to the dynamic world of the energy industry. Our goal is to cultivate the foundational leadership skills (i.e. critical thinking, open communication, leadership, job knowledge, initiative, innovation, and corporate citizenship) needed to improve business outcomes, lead high performing teams, and to grow as an agile leader.

This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan.

We recruit highly motivated candidates with a proven track record of leadership, teamwork, and collaboration skills. If you are a flexible learner who is intellectually curious, committed to delivering results, supportive of others, and resilient in the face of change, this is the right opportunity for you. Over the programs history, successful LDP graduates have matriculated across their careers into leadership positions in the Con Edison companies, including the C-Suite.

Our program consists of:

Three (3) intensive six-month rotational assignments throughout the New York City, Westchester and Rockland Counties designed to grow your knowledge of our operations and how we do business.

At least one supervisory assignment in an operations environment leading a team of employees.

Ongoing coaching and feedback from our best-in-class LDP support team.

Delivering formal presentations to company leaders at the end of each assignment, showcasing your depth of knowledge, key process improvement recommendations, accomplishments, and lessons learned.

Cross-functional training to develop your leadership and technical skill sets while also cultivating your knowledge of the energy industry.

This is an entry level position.

Con Edison provides a strong network of support for our Management Associates. Each Associate is assigned an LDP Committee, LDP Supervisor, Assignment Manager, Mentor, and a Peer Mentor. After completing the program, LDP Associates may apply for permanent positions in the company.
